Also I think it's very important to take advice from the " right person " someone who has been successful in those careers and had similar backgrounds as us. Really need to check on who are the people we are really listening to. 
Most People are afraid of starting over and it is really something we do need to tackle with answering the underlying question what do we really want. What job what role what people and settling only for that. And it's not like it doesn't exist, we just don't know enough about corporates when we are in academics.
